He played [[college basketball]] player for the [[James Madison Dukes men's basketball|James Madison Dukes]]. ==College career== Lewis starred at [[Bishop O'Connell High School]] in [[Arlington, Virginia]] and chose [[James Madison University]] (JMU) for college. He entered the starting lineup for the Dukes, averaging 14.5 points and 3.5 rebounds per game in his freshman season, earning [[Colonial Athletic Association]] (CAA) All-Rookie Team honors.{{cite web|title=Mosley, Lewis, Banks Pick Up All-League Honors|url=https://jmusports.com/news/2018/3/2/mens-basketball-mosley-lewis-banks-pick-up-all-league-honors.aspx|work=[[James Madison Dukes]]|date=March 2, 2018|access-date=February 24, 2021}} Lewis followed this up with a sophomore year where he averaged 16.4 points, 4.2 rebounds and 3.2 assists, garnering third-team All-CAA honors. In his junior year, Lewis again improved his scoring average to 19 points per game and earned second-team All-CAA honors, though the Dukes experienced little on-court success, finishing in last place. After head coach [[Louis Rowe (basketball)|Louis Rowe]] was fired, Lewis chose to declare for the [[2020 NBA draft]], though he retained his college eligibility by not hiring an agent.{{cite web|first=Mike|last=Shiers|title=JMU junior guard Matt Lewis declares for NBA Draft|url=https://www.nbc29.com/2020/04/15/jmu-junior-guard-matt-lewis-declares-nba-draft/|work=nbc29.com|date=April 15, 2020|access-date=February 24, 2021}} Ultimately Lewis decided to return to JMU for his senior season under new coach [[Mark Byington]], who helped advise Lewis and his family through the testing process.{{cite web|first=Dave|last=Fawcett|title=After flirting with the NBA, Woodbridge resident, O'Connell graduate Matt Lewis returns as JMU's leader|url=https://www.insidenova.com/sports/prince_william/after-flirting-with-the-nba-woodbridge-resident-oconnell-graduate-matt-lewis-returns-as-jmus-leader/article_94d4e0ac-2d99-11eb-84f6-7f4346cae3a6.html|work=Inside NOVA|date=November 25, 2020|access-date=February 24, 2021}} In advance of his senior season, Lewis was chosen as the preseason CAA Player of the Year, although the Dukes were predicted to finish ninth in the 10-team league.{{cite web|first=John|last=O'Connor|title=JMU's Matt Lewis earns CAA preseason hoops honor; Dukes, Tribe picked low|url=https://richmond.com/sports/college/james-madison/jmus-matt-lewis-earns-caa-preseason-hoops-honor-dukes-tribe-picked-low/article_867563fd-0536-573c-8966-b4f20b0ce902.html|work=whsv.com|date=November 11, 2020|access-date=February 24, 2021}} While the [[2020–21 James Madison Dukes men's basketball team|Dukes' 2020–21 season]] were paused several times due to [[COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19]] protocols, both Lewis and the Dukes team experienced success. Lewis was named the national player of the week by the [[United States Basketball Writers Association]] on January 17, 2021, after hitting a school record nine [[three-pointers]] in a 30-point effort against [[Towson Tigers men's basketball|Towson]].{{cite web|title=James Madison's Lewis is Oscar Robertson national player of the week|url=https://www.whsv.com/2021/01/20/lewis-playing-best-basketball-of-jmu-career/|work=[[United States Basketball Writers Association]]|date=January 19, 2021|access-date=February 24, 2021}}{{cite web|first=T. J.|last=Eck|title=Lewis playing best basketball of JMU career|url=https://www.whsv.com/2021/01/20/lewis-playing-best-basketball-of-jmu-career/|work=whsv.com|date=January 20, 2021|access-date=February 24, 2021}} Lewis' 2020–21 season ended prematurely when he suffered a knee injury on February 14, 2021, and was later ruled out for the remainder of the year.{{cite web|first=T. J.|last=Eck|title=Lewis out for remainder of season|url=https://www.whsv.com/2021/02/26/lewis-out-for-remainder-of-season/|work=whsv.com|date=February 26, 2021|access-date=February 26, 2021}} On March 5, he was named the 2021 [[Colonial Athletic Association Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Colonial Athletic Association Player of the Year]].{{cite press release |url=https://caasports.com/news/2021/3/5/jmus-lewis-headlines-2020-21-caa-mens-basketball-postseason-awards.aspx|title=JMU's Lewis headlines 2020-21 CAA men's basketball postseason
